# hg skills

**What this page tells you:** every `hg skills` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

Prepare, approve, install and check locked per-agent skill packages.

## Synopsis

```text
hg skills prepare [flags]
hg skills approve [flags]
hg skills install [flags]
hg skills check [flags]
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## Description

Reads per-agent skills.yaml and skills.lock.yaml. Preparation stages complete packages outside source without running upstream code. Human approvals belong to bootstrap. Installation vendors approved packages; checks and deployment are offline. Updates never resolve silently.

## `hg skills prepare`

```text
hg skills prepare [flags]
```

Stage packages and their lock for human review.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dir` | `<source-root>` | — | Agent application repository. |
| `--agent` | `<name>` | — | Receiving Eve agent; required. |
| `--subject` | `<repository#agent>` | — | Credential-free source repository URL (without .git) and agent identity. |
| `--stage` | `<directory>` | — | New directory outside source; defaults under HG_HOME/skill-reviews. |
| `--update` | `<names>` | — | Comma-separated skills explicitly allowed to resolve again. |
| `--credential-env` | `<name>` | — | Environment reference for private upstream Git access; never a credential value. |
| `--requirements` | `<file>` | — | YAML list of local skill requirements to include in the same review. |

## `hg skills approve`

```text
hg skills approve [flags]
```

Record explicit human approval of a review fingerprint.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--review` | `<file>` | — | Staged review.json; required. |
| `--approval-file` | `<file>` | — | Bootstrap-owned approval file; required. |
| `--approver` | `<identity>` | — | Human who explicitly approved this review; required. |
| `--fingerprint` | `<sha256>` | — | Exact fingerprint presented during review; required. |

## `hg skills install`

```text
hg skills install [flags]
```

Install approved packages and lock into agent source.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dir` | `<source-root>` | — | Agent application repository. |
| `--agent` | `<name>` | — | Receiving Eve agent; required. |
| `--review` | `<file>` | — | Reviewed staged review.json; required. |
| `--approval-file` | `<file>` | — | Bootstrap-owned approvals outside source; required. |

## `hg skills check`

```text
hg skills check [flags]
```

Verify manifest, lock and installed packages offline.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dir` | `<source-root>` | — | Agent application repository. |
| `--agent` | `<name>` | — | Receiving Eve agent; required. |
